tests/FullHostGuardTests.m.note: Full 1.0.21/1 host (ios1021, C20 onward; tests/FullHostFixture.h): every business-9 frame goes through the one flash gate; at stage 0 only the empty reads 1, 2, 11 and the exact size query pass, in the same five TIO_* flag sets as ios1021-download-guard with one sweep digest, equal to its pin. tests/FlashPackagesTests.m.note: The release's two packages (TMG12 first, stock 1.0.6.11 second) through the real guard and gate on the full 1.0.21 host, with both real ZIPs unzipped: a new process selects TMG12; with stock selected the recorded 1.0.21 sequence replays with the stock size, manifest and slices and is allowed (slice totals computed by test.py from the stock ZIP); each package's authorization refuses the other's manifest and nuttx_ap.bin slice; type 3 with the other package's size is refused at stages 0, 1 and 2; a selection change at stage 1 cancels the authorization, and at stages 2 and 3 is refused with the capture unchanged; a capture for a package index that is not the selected one is refused as changed, each way; with a test-only package table (stock accepts only 1.0.6.11) a version the selected package does not accept refuses authorization.

tests/FlashSequenceTests.m.note: Replays the 1.0.21 flash sequence recorded on 2026-11-15 (tests/flash-sequence-1021.json: frame order, JSON shapes, file order and slice size) through the real guard and gate on the full 1.0.21 host, with the slices cut from the --firmware ZIP: every frame allowed, stage 2 reached, 313 slices and 15,741,262 bytes. Eleven mutations are each refused: no authorization, Mode other than 2, a wrong OtaVersion, a changed manifest, a slice before the manifest, a flipped slice byte, an unpinned name, a slice past the end of its file, another device, an authorization older than 15 minutes, and a second type 4 after the start (then stage 3).
